headline: A Local Agent Runs the Job Hunt
lede: AI Job Search turns a personal archive of CVs, references, applications, and credentials into a repeatable application pipeline. Its local-first design combines fit scoring, tailored documents, review stages, interview preparation, and outcome tracking without sending the whole search into a hosted black box.

headline: An Agent Audit That Demands Proof
lede: Cloudflare’s security-audit-skill divides reconnaissance, vulnerability hunting, and verification into a six-phase adversarial workflow. Structured ledgers separate confirmed findings from leads and rejects, making every reported weakness carry an evidence trail rather than a confident guess.

headline: Orca Brings Coding Agents Under One Roof
lede: Orca coordinates Codex, ClaudeCode, OpenCode, and Pi across isolated worktrees, persistent terminals, editors, and remote machines. Its GitHub, Linear, SSH, mobile, and diff-review surfaces turn parallel agent experiments into a manageable engineering workspace.

headline: Ponytail Teaches Agents to Write Less
lede: Ponytail injects a deliberately frugal rulebook into coding agents: check the platform, standard library, and existing code before adding anything new. The result is an experiment in reducing lines, dependencies, latency, and cost without trading away safety, accessibility, or error handling.

headline: ComfyUI Turns Generative Workflows Into Graphs
lede: ComfyUI makes image, video, audio, 3D, and text generation visible as a connected node graph. Saved JSON workflows, partial reruns, model offloading, and broad support for open models give artists and engineers precise control over every stage of the frame.

headline: Ruflo Builds an Operating System for Agents
lede: Ruflo places more than 100 specialized agents, persistent memory, swarms, and workflow routing behind a single execution layer. Its Rust engine, federated communication, vector storage, and plugin architecture are aimed at turning isolated coding assistants into coordinated engineering systems.

headline: Graphify Maps the Repository Behind the Code
lede: Graphify converts source, documentation, schemas, PDFs, screenshots, and diagrams into a queryable knowledge graph. Deterministic extraction sits beside clearly labeled inferred and ambiguous relationships, while caching, watch mode, and Git hooks keep the map synchronized as the repository changes.

headline: dsh-purge Tests the Harness Around the Model
lede: dsh-purge examines how prompts, approvals, sandbox settings, and session handling shape DeepSeek Harness behavior on local Web and desktop installations. With patch management, rollback, and an explicitly authorized offline testing mode, it gives researchers a controlled way to separate model refusals from host-level restrictions.

headline: OpenCode Pushes the Coding Agent Mainstream
lede: OpenCode pairs a CLI and desktop interface with plan and build agents, permission-gated shell access, and guarded file edits. At 218,329 stars, its scale reflects the demand for an open, configurable coding assistant that remains explicit about what it can change.

headline: Agency Agents Catalogs a Ready-Made AI Workforce
lede: Agency Agents collects specialized roles as structured Markdown profiles spanning development, design, marketing, operations, and security. Installation scripts and a companion desktop app let teams assemble focused divisions across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, OpenCode, and other agent environments.
